challenge.en: Scaling 3D optical metrology to high mounting heights with large FOV image stitching across 12 stereo camera pairs.
challenge.zh-TW: 將 3D 光學量測擴展至高架設高度與大視野影像拼接，涵蓋 12 組立體相機。

solution.en: Designed multi-camera calibration algorithms, implemented large FOV image stitching, and advanced the MVP prototype to factory line testing.
solution.zh-TW: 設計多相機立體標定演算法與大視野影像拼接管線，將量測原型推進至產線測試。

boundary.en: Focused on camera calibration, stereo algorithm design, high-height FOV stitching, and factory line testing.
boundary.zh-TW: 專注於相機標定、立體視覺演算法設計、高空大視野拼接與工廠產線測試。

aInput.en: Perspective distortion and seam artifacts from high-height multi-camera placement
aInput.zh-TW: 高空多相機架設導致的透視畸變與大視野拼接接縫

weakestLink.en: Extrinsic calibration drift and optical distortion across 12 stereo camera pairs
weakestLink.zh-TW: 12 組立體相機的外參標定漂移與光學畸變

bOutput.en: Large FOV stereo stitching algorithms with verified measurement accuracy in factory testing
bOutput.zh-TW: 大視野立體拼接演算法，通過工廠產線測試驗證

strictInvariant.en: Stereo 3D measurement geometry across stitched frames must match physical calibration target coordinates.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 大視野拼接影像的立體 3D 量測幾何必須與實體標定靶標座標保持一致。

en: Modifying conveyor mechanical assemblies on the production line
zh-TW: 改造產線輸送帶的機械結構
自研專用影像感測器硬體

failureConditions.en: If mechanical vibration or thermal changes exceed calibration tolerances, the system prompts for recalibration instead of outputting invalid measurements.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若機械震動或溫度變化超出標定容差，系統自動提示重新標定，不輸出錯誤量測結果。

challenger.en: What was the main calibration challenge when measuring from high mounting heights with large FOV stitching?
challenger.zh-TW: 在高架設高度進行大視野拼接量測時，主要的相機標定挑戰是什麼？

defense.en: High mounting heights introduce perspective distortion and edge illumination dropoff across camera pairs. We built a bundle-adjustment calibration pipeline that solved intrinsic and extrinsic parameters together, removing parallax seams in stitched 3D point clouds.
defense.zh-TW: 高架設高度會帶來透視畸變與相機邊緣光學衰減。我們設計光學標定演算法，同時解算內外參矩陣，消除拼接點雲中的視差接縫。

challenger.en: How did you advance the prototype from MVP to factory testing?
challenger.zh-TW: 你如何將 C++/Python 3D 量測原型推進至工廠產線測試？

defense.en: We defined factory test specifications, integrated the vision pipeline into line inspection workflows, and verified measurement repeatability during 8-hour continuous runs with thermal drift compensation targets.
defense.zh-TW: 我們制定工廠測試規格，將演算法管線整合至產線檢測流程，並在 8 小時連續運轉下透過熱漂移補償靶標驗證量測重複精度。

staff.en: Multi-camera calibration, large FOV stereo stitching, and prototyping to factory testing
staff.zh-TW: 多相機立體標定、大視野影像拼接與產線測試驗證

coreQuestion.en: How do we achieve precise 3D measurement from high mounting heights across 12 stereo camera pairs without seam artifacts?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 如何在 12 組立體相機高空架設下達成精確 3D 量測，同時消除大視野拼接接縫？

breakthrough.en: Designed multi-camera optical calibration and stereo stitching algorithms with global optimization, advancing the prototype to factory line testing.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 研發多相機光學標定與全域優化立體拼接演算法，將原型推進至工廠產線測試。

verifiedMoat.en: Large FOV 3D optical metrology across 12 stereo pairs, with verified measurement repeatability on the production line.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 完成 12 組立體相機大視野 3D 光學量測，在產線環境下驗證量測重複精度。

em.en: Cross-functional tuning, prototype delivery, and factory testing milestones
em.zh-TW: 跨部門調校、原型交付與產線測試里程碑

coreQuestion.en: How do you coordinate algorithm integration, camera calibration, and hardware tuning across teams?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 如何協調跨部門的演算法整合、相機標定與硬體調校？

breakthrough.en: Established calibration and testing protocols so software iteration and hardware validation could proceed in parallel.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 建立模組化標定與測試規範，讓演算法軟體開發與硬體驗證同步進行。

verifiedMoat.en: Delivered the prototype to factory testing on schedule and verified measurement stability before production rollout.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 如期將原型推進至工廠產線測試，在量產前確立量測穩定度。

coreQuestion.zh-TW: Blake 為工業 3D 檢測系統建立了哪些技術基礎？

verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 建立完整的 3D 光學量測管線，直接將原型推進至工廠產線測試。
